steps.body: Sometimes the line shows the start and the landing but hides the jump: the missing jump is the gap between them — a subtraction in disguise.
steps.narration: Sometimes the line shows the start and the landing but hides the jump: the missing jump is the gap between them — a subtraction in disguise.

widget.prompt: The start was 40 and the landing 70. Rebuild the missing jump: three ten-hops.

commonLandings.feedback: One ten rebuilt of three — keep hopping until the landing matches 70.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 10, going forward. From 40, 3 hops land on 70.
widget.successFeedback: 70 — the rebuilt jump measures exactly 30, the gap the drawing hid.

predict.prompt: Start 40, landing 70, jump unknown. How do you find it?
predict.reveal: The jump is the distance between landing and start — a difference, never a sum.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2l missing jump.
invariants: Position on the line IS the number: equal jumps cover equal amounts, and a journey's landing depends only on start, jump size, and direction for g2l missing jump.
misconceptions: Treating marks as decoration — unequal spacing, jumps of the wrong size, or reading a start mark as a landing.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which change — start, jump size, or direction — would move the landing, and which would leave it alone?

commonErrors.feedback: Adding the two marks measures nothing — the missing jump is their DIFFERENCE.
That jump falls short of 74; the full gap is the jump.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Walk the line: find the start mark, take the jumps one at a time, and read the mark you land on.

hints: The difference is the space between.

steps.body: Reconstruct a missing route in the opposite direction from a new landing point.

widget.prompt: A route starts at 72 and ends 20 lower. Rebuild it with two ten-hops backward.

commonLandings.feedback: That rebuilds only one ten of the hidden route. A 20-unit gap needs two ten-hops.

widget.missFeedback: The hidden change is 20. Two backward ten-hops from 72 land on 52.
widget.successFeedback: 52 — the rebuilt route measures the full 20-unit gap.

widget.prompt: Which drawing shows the gap between 43 and 33?

options.label: Drawing A
options.feedback: Correct — the difference is the distance separating the two marks, hopped and counted.

options.label: Drawing B
options.feedback: Forward jumps grow the number; a difference either walks BACK or measures the gap.

options.label: Drawing C
options.feedback: That mark is the ANSWER, but a drawing of the difference must show where it came from.

options.label: Drawing D
options.feedback: Adding the endpoints measures no distance at all — the gap between them is the difference.

hints: The difference is the space between.
